name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 6 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-05-16, at wavelengths from 1.66 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
